mapper.insert: INSERT INTO catalogues (title, description, coverImage) VALUES (#{title}, #{description}, #{coverImage})
mapper.update: UPDATE catalogues SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, coverImage = #{coverImage} WHERE catalogueId = #{catalogueId}
mapper.select: SELECT catalogueId, title, description, coverImage FROM catalogues ORDER BY updateTime DESC, catalogueId DESC
SELECT catalogueId, title, description, coverImage FROM catalogues WHERE catalogueId = #{catalogueId}
